summary: Sangamo Therapeutics filed an 8-K reporting a change in certifying accountant after its Chapter 11 bankruptcy filing (Case No. 26-10989) on June 24, 2026. The company terminated Ernst & Young LLP as auditor on June 25, 2026, with EY's prior reports including a going-concern paragraph. The common stock had been suspended from Nasdaq on May 5, 2026, later trading on OTCQB and then OTCID Basic Market (symbol SGMOQ). The voluntary petition represents a restructuring under U.S. bankruptcy law. What to watch: court proceedings on reorganization plan and potential recovery for equity holders, typically minimal in Chapter 11.
